description: This file defines the ExecutionContext and JSHandle classes for managing JavaScript execution contexts and handles within the Playwright core server, including evaluation functions, handle management, and related utilities.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript execution context, providing methods to evaluate scripts, manage handles, and handle context lifecycle.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a JavaScript object within an execution context, allowing evaluation and property access.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function or script within the execution context, returning the result.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a string expression within the execution context with options for return type.

methods.name: parseUnserializableValue
methods.description: Parses special string representations of unserializable values like NaN, Infinity, etc.

methods.name: normalizeEvaluationExpression
methods.description: Normalizes a string expression for evaluation, wrapping functions as needed.

methods.name: JavaScriptErrorInEvaluate
methods.description: Custom error class for errors occurring during script evaluation.

methods.name: isJavaScriptErrorInEvaluate
methods.description: Checks if an error is an instance of JavaScriptErrorInEvaluate.

methods.name: sparseArrayToString
methods.description: Converts sparse array entries to a string representation.
